comment: Parked vehicles in the game (decision G-110). The Three.js game's parking (`content.ts`, baked by Rules into src/missions/content/content.json) is read from there; this file maps its kinds to vehicle variants and adds the vehicles the Three.js game did not park: taxis at the stations and in T. Nagar, the premium cars in the richer districts, the race car at the race track. `near` is a world point (metres, +X east, -Z north) taken from the place's latitude and longitude; the spot is the kerb of the nearest drivable road in the loaded data, so it follows the map when the data is rebuilt. Places are real; the exact spots are invented.

spots.place: Boat Club Road, R. A. Puram
